FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 176
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/09/2024
Senate Bill 176 as introduced would increase the administrative and financial obligations of the
Alabama Community College System (ACCS) to: (1) develop and implement workforce
exploration modules, to be provided to each local board of education beginning with the
2025-2026 school year to meet graduation requirements beginning with the 2028-2029
graduating class; (2) develop a list of Career RoadMap opportunities for each high school
student to complete at no costs to the student; and (3) adopt policies and procedures to
implement and administer the provision of this bill.
Additionally, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board of
Education to adopt rules to implement the workforce exploration modules developed by ACCS
and to ensure that high school graduation requirements meet the provisions of this bill.
Finally, this would increase the administrative obligations of local boards of education to adopt
policies relating to the Career RoadMap Postsecondary Opportunities (CRPO) and to
collaborate with the local community college to facilitate CRPO and assist with the
administration module.
